a: Bernard (1090–1153) yayingira ennyumba y'abamonaki empya eryali lifuba ng'aweza emyaka amakumi abiri mu ebiri, ng'aleeta ne banne amakumi asatu, era yafuuka abbot ng'aweza emyaka amakumi abiri mu etaano okumala emyaka amakumi asatu mu munaana egyasigalawo mu bulamu bwe. Yassaawo paapa, n'agoberera Abelard okutuusa lwe yasingibwa omusango, n'abuulira olutalo lw'eddiini olwagwa n'akabi kanene, era mu myaka gye gimu n'awandiika Ku Kwagala Katonda n'ebibuulirwa kinaana mu mukaaga ku Luyimba lwa Sulemaani. Yali musajja eyasinga obuyinza mu Bulaaya mu kyasa eky'ekkumi n'ebibiri, songa teyalina kifo kya buyinza kyonna kya makulu — yali abbot, si kirala kyonna.

q: Yatuuka atya e Cîteaux era n'atandikawo atya Clairvaux?
a: Yazaalibwa mu 1090 okumpi ne Dijon, nga ye mwana ow'okusatu owa munnamaggye Omuburugundi, era mu 1113 yeewaayo e Cîteaux — ekkomera ly'abamonaki ery'engeri enkyusibwe era ery'obukalubu obw'ekigendererwa, eryali kumpi okugwa olw'obutaba na bantu abayingira — era teyajja bw'omu, wabula n'abasajja nga amakumi asatu be yali amaze emyezi mingi ng'asendasenda. Nga wayiseewo emyaka ebiri, abbot yamutuma n'abamonaki kkumi na babiri okuzimba ekkomera omuwala mu kiwonvu mu Champagne. Baalituuma Clairvaux, era yali abbot waalyo okumala emyaka amakumi asatu mu munaana, era okuva mu lyo ne muva amakomera amalala amakumi mukaaga mu munaana.

Kaadinaali yali amubuuzizza lwaki Katonda asaanira okwagalibwa era n'okumwagala kumeka, Bernard n'addamu mu sentensi ebbiri ezisooka: "ensonga ey'okwagala Katonda ye Katonda yennyini; n'ekigero ky'okwagala kwe asaanira kwe kwagala okutabalika." Ekitabo kyonna kyesigamye ku kugaana kumu — nti okwagala kwa Katonda tekuyinza kupimibwa okwesigamye ku kintu kyonna. Okuddamu kwe ku "kumeka" si mugero wabula kwe kusaanyaawo ekibuuzo.

Bernard annyonnyola okwagala nga kutuuka mu mitendera. Omuntu atandika n'okwagala ye yennyini ku lulwe, era awo we watandikira buli muntu; ng'ali mu kunyigirizibwa, ayiga okwagala Katonda olw'ebyo Katonda by'amuwa — okwagala okunoonya obw'omuntu ye, Bernard kw'atanyooma; oluvannyuma atuuka ku kwagala Katonda ku lwa Katonda yennyini. Ate era, obutasingira ddala era mu kiseera kitono, waliwo ogw'okuna: okwagala omuntu yennyini mu Katonda yekka. Ayogera mu bwesimbu nti ye yennyini teyabeererayo, ng'akuyita okusikirizibwa kw'omwoyo okw'akaseera katono bukyawulira mu bulamu buno.

q: Obuyinza bwe obw'oku lujjudde bwali butya?
a: Okuva nga mu 1130 ensi ey'ebweru yamukwata. Okulonda paapa okwaleeta empaka kwayawula Bulaaya, era okuwagira kwe kwe kwasinga buli kintu okufuula Innocent II paapa; yayitibwa okutereeza ennyombo, okwekenneenya babisopi n'okumalawo empaka mu Bufalansa, Butaliyaana ne Budaaki. Ebbaluwa ze ebikumi ebiwonyeewo ziraga omusajja eyeemulugunya nnyo olw'okucaacaana kw'emirimu naye nga akyeyongera okugiragira — omumonaki eyava mu nsi ng'aweza emyaka amakumi abiri mu ebiri n'akomekkereza ng'agiddukanya.

q: Okulwanagana kwe ne Abelard kwali kutya?
a: Yagoberera Peter Abelard, omunnamawulire w'eddiini eyasinga amagezi era eyasinga obukambwe mu mulembe ogwo, okutuusa lwe yasingibwa omusango e Sens mu 1140, ng'akkiririza nti Abelard yali afuula ebyama by'okukkiriza okuba empaka z'endowooza, ate Abelard ng'akkiririza nti Bernard yali ateeka obunyiikivu mu kifo ky'okulowooza. Abasomi ab'omu mulembe guno awamu bali ku ludda lwa Abelard, era n'abo abatali ku ludda lwe batera okusanga enkola za Bernard mu kulwana okwo nga nzibu okuwolereza; yali asobola okuba omukambwe, era teyamanyanga bulijjo we yabeereranga omukambwe olw'ensonga ye ye.

q: Kiki ekyaliwo ku Lutalo lw'Eddiini olw'Okubiri?
a: Mu 1146, ku kiragiro kya Paapa Eugenius III — eyali omumonaki we e Clairvaux edda — Bernard yabuulira Olutalo lw'Eddiini olw'Okubiri, era yali asikiriza nnyo: ebibiina byali binene nnyo, era bakabaka babiri ne beetikka omusaalaba. Olugendo terwavaamu kantu wabula okufiirwa kwa bantu bangi nnyo. Teyakyekweka; mu Ku Kufumiitiriza yayolekera obuzibu obwo butereevu mu kifo ky'okunoonya ennyonnyola ennyangu, era n'assa obuzito bwabwo ku ye yennyini — ekimu ku bintu ebisaanira okumuwa ekitiibwa kwe kuba nti yawandiika ku bulemerevu bwe obusinga obubi.

q: Kiki kye yakola ku kutta abantu mu Rhineland?
a: Omumonaki ayitibwa Radulf yali amukulembedde ng'abuulira olutalo, ng'akubiriza okutta abantu Abayudaaya mu bibuga bya Rhine. Bernard yagendayo okumuziyiza — ng'amwolekera yekka, ng'amuzzaayo mu kkomera lye, era ng'akakasa mu kuwandiika nti Abayudaaya tebaali ba kukwatibwako. Kyakola, era abawandiisi b'ebyafaayo Abayudaaya ab'omu kiseera ekyo baawandiika okwebaza kwabwe; naye kya mazima nti n'olutalo lwe yayita lwe lwaleeta embeera Radulf gye yakozesa. Ebitundu byombi bibye.

q: Ebibuulirwa bye ku Luyimba lwa Sulemaani bye biruwa?
a: Mu mirimu gye gyonna egy'oku lujjudde yali abuulira, mu nkuŋŋaana z'abamonaki e Clairvaux, olukalala lw'ebibuulirwa ku Luyimba lwa Sulemaani — kinaana mu mukaaga mu myaka kkumi na munaana, nga atuuse ku ntandikwa y'essuula ey'okusatu ey'ekitabo yokka. Ze ntikko y'empandiika ye era n'ey'enkola yonna ey'okusoma oluyimba olwo ng'okwagala okuli wakati wa Kristo n'emmeeme: ez'enneewulira, entuufu, ezitegeera omutima gw'omuntu, era ezitali na nsonyi n'akatono. Yali akyazikolako bwe yafa.

Yafiira e Clairvaux nga 20 Agusito 1153, ng'akooye ng'aweza emyaka nkaaga mu esatu, obulamu bwe nga bwali bwayonooneka olw'emyaka egy'okusiiba gye yakkiriza oluvannyuma nti gyali gya busirusiru. Luther, eyalina obugumiikiriza butono eri abatukuvu ab'omu mulembe ogwa wakati, yamukolera enjawulo; Calvin yamujuliza; Dante n'amuwa ekigambo eky'enkomerero mu Paradiso. Ekisaanira okuggya ku Bernard si buwanguzi bwa by'obufuzi, obwasinga okufuuka enfuufu, wabula okuwakana kwe okutakoma nti obusobozi si kye kikulu, era nti ekigero kyokka ekituufu eky'okwagala kwa Katonda kwe kuba nti tekiriiwo.
